description: This file defines the SavedSearch class for managing saved search configurations in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, displaying, and deleting saved searches, as well as handling form inputs and redirections.

classes.name: SavedSearch
classes.description: A class extending SugarBean, responsible for handling saved search objects including creation, retrieval, display, deletion, and form processing within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SavedSearch object, setting columns, order, custom fields, and mapping field names.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates the HTML form for creating or editing a saved search, including populating search options.

methods.name: getTemplateGroupChooser
methods.description: Returns a TemplateGroupChooser object configured for display columns selection.

methods.name: getSelect
methods.description: Returns HTML for a dropdown list of saved searches for the specified module.

methods.name: returnSavedSearch
methods.description: Redirects to a URL that loads a specific saved search based on its ID.

methods.name: returnSavedSearchContents
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the contents of a saved search for a given ID.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Marks a saved search as deleted and redirects to the list view.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form data to save or update a saved search, including validation and redirection.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Performs a redirection to a specified URL after save or delete operations.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills additional fields like search_module name and assigned user name.

methods.name: retrieveSavedSearch
methods.description: Loads a saved search from the database into the current object.

methods.name: populateRequest
methods.description: Populates PHP $_REQUEST array with saved search contents for display or editing.
